# Wharf 0.12.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Build, agent, and verifier phases have independent resource gates.
- Timeout policy supports phase defaults, multipliers, and explicit overrides.
- Retryable infrastructure failures retry only within the configured bound.
- Deterministic/excluded failures are not retried.
- Infrastructure retry evidence has its own IDs and schema and does not alter
  logical-attempt identity or counts.
- Phase capacity is released before retry evidence is written.

## Validation evidence

Formatting verification, Release build, and the complete suite passed all 64
tests with zero warnings or errors.
